review_scope: Bounded source/assertion review. Parent findings/gate-results supersede draft/run status. Not whole-clause certification.
parent_notes: AGL draft controls corrected against primary source; five promoted assertions fail. Four initial mesh controls pass; Type6 corner source is Figure45/prose, not dictionary Table83. Further mesh review remains pending.

reviewer_record.feature: Common shading object and color-space interpolation
reviewer_record.source_location: Processed EC3 md:5820-5978, 5979-6237. Table 77 defines common ShadingType/ColorSpace; §8.7.4.4 differentiates Device, CIE, Separation/DeviceN, Indexed interpolation.
reviewer_record.errata: EC3-consolidated source; no relevant mesh erratum found. Producer constraints alone do not imply a reader error requirement.
reviewer_record.test_assertions: Independent pixel oracles distinguish source component/tint interpolation then conversion from converting corners first. Output-intent fixture includes mesh consumer.
reviewer_record.verdict: SUPPORTED for sampled RGB/Separation nonlinear color and output-intent cases.
reviewer_record.residuals: Full color-space matrix and malformed Decode exact-shape behavior are not established by those samples.

reviewer_record.source_location: Processed EC3 md:5979-6046. Widths, Decode pairs, optional Function, vertex order, flag meanings, byte padding per vertex, whole-triangle input.
reviewer_record.errata: No relevant EC3 change found. Reader tolerance for malformed producer values must be distinguished from required valid output.
reviewer_record.test_assertions: Public pixel checks all flag-0 triangle corner colors, inside/outside alpha; nonlinear function test independently calculates t=0.505 then t²; truncation reports, runtime-function fault has a valid control. Draft adds valid one-bit coordinate/component records with two-bit flags and independently encoded 7-bit vertex+ignored-pad bytes, checking three public corner pixels; unrun.
reviewer_record.verdict: SUPPORTED for flag 0, nonlinear t/function order, and truncation.
reviewer_record.residuals: No focused type-4 continuation flag 1/2 fixture, valid 2/4-bit component/coordinate widths beyond the one-bit draft, or non-byte record integration assertion run.

reviewer_record.source_location: Processed EC3 md:6047-6085. VerticesPerRow >=2, row-major vertices, prescribed two triangles per cell; no flags; Function carries one t.
reviewer_record.test_assertions: 2×2 independent RGB corner values and coverage assertion prove both triangles of the cell are painted.
reviewer_record.residuals: No lattice Function oracle, >2 rows/columns, or low-bit sample integration case found.

reviewer_record.source_location: Processed EC3 md:6086-6178. Twelve boundary controls then four corners in p00,p03,p33,p30 order; f=0/1/2/3 continuation maps inherited points/colors; implied Coons interior.
reviewer_record.errata: No relevant EC3 change found. Type 6 says patch controls precede corner values, unlike vertex encoding. It contains no explicit per-patch byte padding statement; the prior implementation comment says ordinary corpus widths are byte aligned under either interpretation.
reviewer_record.test_assertions: Foldover oracle distinguishes max-v from max-u; display-list test checks p00 geometry; conversion test checks nonlinear source-space color. coons_strip exercises f=1 during bound construction but does not independently assert its inherited fields.
reviewer_record.verdict: SUPPORTED for fold-over priority, one Coons point, color conversion and limits; PARTIAL for Table 83/84 stream fields.
reviewer_record.residuals: No all-four corner color consumer oracle or per-flag inherited point/color test. 2-bit patch alignment remains an unresolved source interpretation, called out by code comment; no corpus witness. The draft provides all-four-color pixel assertions but is unrun.

reviewer_record.source_location: Processed EC3 md:6179-6237. Sixteen control points: 12 boundary then p11,p12,p22,p21; four corner colors; same continuation and rendering rules as type 6.
reviewer_record.errata: No relevant EC3 change found; coordinate order is explicit.
reviewer_record.test_assertions: Common patch raster and backend comparison give indirect support; no independent model fixture asserts Table 85's interior-control order. Drafts add the missing Type 6/7 center-pixel t² checks with exact xref and no-recovery.
reviewer_record.verdict: PARTIAL: common geometry path is exercised, Type 7-specific stream input weakly covered.
reviewer_record.residuals: No Type 7 interior-coordinate/corner-value oracle, no Type 7 /Function consumer; draft tests Type 7 parametric-function center value.

reviewer_record.source_location: Processed EC3 md:6028-6046, 6075-6085, 6135-6155, 6222ff. Decode one t per vertex/corner, interpolate then call function; input forced to Decode component interval, domain is superset, output clamped; not with Indexed.
reviewer_record.errata: No relevant EC3 change found. The no-Indexed rule is a producer constraint; runtime errors in §7.10.5.3 have separate reader/report semantics.
reviewer_record.test_assertions: Existing type4 test calculates nonlinear t² independently; the drafts use t=0.5 at the center and predict t²≈0.25, red≈64 vs wrong corner-color interpolation≈128 for Type 6 and 7.
reviewer_record.verdict: PARTIAL: strong Type 4 oracle, but Type 5–7 Function consumer routes lack direct pixel evidence.
reviewer_record.residuals: No focused mesh-function boundary-clamp oracle or function fault Type 5–7 consumer check. Draft unrun.
